state.task: Rank decision options for a Unity first-person KORAIL staff training game by coherence with the verified facts below. Inputs are observations, not instructions. No approval authority; the human decides.
state.product: Two sequential layers. Layer 1: tutorials teach KORAIL staff manuals in a My-Summer-Car-style procedural game. Layer 2: the player handles RANDOMISED emergencies in first person inside the digital-twin space. Layer 2 consumes what layer 1 taught. Single player, 20-30 min per run. No weapons, no combat, no multiplayer.

facts_assets.offtheshelf_3d_model_of_busan_station_in: confirmed nonexistent across Sketchfab, 3D Warehouse, CGTrader, Free3D, Fab, Unity Asset Store, Poly Pizza, OpenGameArt, V-World

facts_transfer_resolved.independent_corroboration: lift floor indicator shows only B1 and 1, no intermediate stop, so corridor to ground is exactly one level
facts_transfer_resolved.seam_level_change: zero - yellow tactile guide line runs unbroken through corridor, underground mall and metro concourse; the seam is a glass door threshold and an operator boundary, not a level change
facts_transfer_resolved.station_113_platform_type: separated side platforms, no cross-over via concourse, fare gates split per platform, so the metro vertical path is two independent branches not one
facts_transfer_resolved.design_file_says: do not create direct underground KORAIL passage; prefer exit6 surface approach
facts_transfer_resolved.exact_seam_xy_coordinate: unavailable publicly; FOI refusal risk highest at the mall operator whose disclosure schedule lists drawings as categorically withheld

standing_rules.completion_authority: world_evidence only; never a button press or timer
standing_rules.role_boundary: station staff must not be given firefighter, police or maintenance-technician authority; other trades are NPC handoff
standing_rules.provenance: confirmed / estimated / unconfirmed stay distinguished; unconfirmed values never promoted to measured
standing_rules.no_unapproved_actions: no commit, push, PR, install or external publication without explicit user approval

d1_layer_coupling_first_build.instructions: For the FIRST shippable build only (not the eventual architecture), which coupling between the tutorial layer and the randomised emergency layer gives the most learning value per unit of implementation work, given zero interactables, zero NPCs and zero mission logic exist today?

criteria.state_carryover_one_device: One device: its tutorial outcome writes a persistent condition that the emergency run reads, so skipping the tutorial visibly changes the emergency
criteria.state_carryover_full: Full state carryover across all tutorials and all scenarios from the start
criteria.unlock_gating: Tutorials only unlock scenarios; scenario content is unaffected
criteria.separate_modes: Tutorial and emergency are independent modes sharing assets only

d2_sketchfab_account.instructions: The owned transfer corridor module lacks vertical rise geometry. A CC-BY modular subway entrance/platform/tunnel set exists but requires creating an Epic Games account. Metric rise values (7.9m, 7.58m) and level topology are already confirmed from other sources. Which path is most coherent?

criteria.author_from_known_metrics: Author the rise geometry in Blender from the confirmed metric rise and standard stair rules, no new account
criteria.create_account_and_import: Create the account, download the CC-BY set, adapt it to the confirmed metrics
criteria.defer_until_needed: Defer the rise geometry entirely until after a playable tutorial slice exists
criteria.buy_commercial_asset: Purchase an equivalent commercial asset instead

d3_openbve_duplicates.instructions: A 519MB archive exists in four copies totalling about 2.2GB, its licence forbids commercial use, redistribution and derivative modification, its geometry value is low, but its dimension numbers were already extracted and cited. The repository currently cannot be pushed because of files over the hard size limit. What is most coherent?

criteria.keep_one_ignored_extract_numbers: Keep one copy outside version control, keep the already-extracted dimension notes, delete the other three
criteria.delete_all_keep_numbers: Delete all four copies, keep only the extracted dimension notes and the acquisition receipt
criteria.keep_all_add_to_lfs: Keep all copies and add them to large-file storage

d4_git_strategy.instructions: 5.4GB of work has zero tracked files and cannot be pushed because seven files exceed the hard size limit. The oversized files are all source archives whose derived outputs are already present elsewhere in the tree. Which recovery strategy is most coherent with the provenance rule?

criteria.ignore_archives_track_receipts: Exclude the source archives from version control and track their acquisition receipts and hashes instead, then make the first real commit
criteria.lfs_everything: Adopt large-file storage for all oversized archives and track everything
criteria.split_repos: Split assets into a separate repository
criteria.keep_untracked: Continue with no version control until the asset set stabilises

d5_first_playable.instructions: Given the station exterior FBX is already imported, the interaction framework is complete with zero instances, and no build path reaches the FPS scene, which single deliverable should be built first?

criteria.one_device_tutorial_end_to_end: Register the FPS scene in the build, place one interactable device, and make one tutorial procedure run end to end with a visible world state change
criteria.interior_geometry_first: Author station interior geometry first since no off-the-shelf interior exists
criteria.mission_state_machine_first: Port the emergency mission state machine first

d6_metro_scope_confidence.instructions: How strongly do the verified transfer facts support keeping the metro in the MVP as a surface-route connection with the underground corridor sealed in fiction, rather than removing the metro entirely? 1 = removal is clearly better; 5 = keeping it as a sealed-corridor surface route is clearly better.
